intro: Our Pangram is made to fit your life. With multiple configurations, plush upholstery, and elegant wooden details, it’s a perfect mix of function and timeless style — always ready for your next moment.

features.title: A touch of dual-tone sophistication
features.text: Crafted with durable two-tone fabric, this sofa feels soft to the touch while standing up to elegance, making it a practical choice for family spaces.

features.title: Hidden storage for a clutter-free space
features.text: The lift-up storage keeps your essentials tucked away yet easily accessible, helping you maintain a clutter-free and organized space effortlessly.

features.title: Fluffy, cozy, made just right
features.text: Sink into cloud-like comfort with soft foam cushioning that cradles your body. Designed for plush support, it enhances relaxation while maintaining its shape for long-lasting coziness.

features.title: A secret spot for everything you need
features.text: Experience elegance and functionality with a wooden-finish armrest featuring built-in side storage. Perfect for keeping essentials close, it adds a touch of warmth while keeping your space organised.

features.title: Tailored comfort with loose cushions
features.text: Soft, portable cushions that adjust to you—whether you’re curling up with a book or stretching out after a long day, they create the perfect cozy spot, just the way you like it.

name: Pangram 5-Seater Fabric L Shape Sofa With Storage
